name: Metformin adherence check-in
description: Routine medication-adherence follow-up for a type-2 diabetes patient.

injections.text: Warmly greet the patient and confirm you are speaking with the right person.
Ask whether they have been taking their metformin as prescribed, twice daily with meals.
Ask if they have noticed any side effects such as nausea or stomach upset.
Gently encourage them to keep taking it consistently and to take it with food to reduce side effects.
Ask if they have any questions, then warmly close the call.

name: Statin side-effect probe
description: Follow-up call focused on possible statin side effects.

injections.text: Greet the patient and confirm their identity in a friendly tone.
Ask whether they have been taking their statin every evening as prescribed.
Ask specifically about muscle aches, weakness, or unusual tiredness.
Reassure them that mild effects are common and advise them to contact their doctor if symptoms are severe.
Thank them for their time and close the call warmly.
